structured_output.summary: The diff implements the DataView.prototype.byteLength getter in its own file. It uses RequireInternalSlot via require_data_view with `?`, then the out-of-bounds check (TypeError), then GetViewByteLength, and returns the size as a Number. Errors propagate correctly, nothing is special-cased, and no unrelated files are touched. The gate shows build and clippy OK, 16 new passes, and 0 regressions. The two remaining failures come from the unimplemented DataView.prototype.buffer getter, which the test harness calls, not from this code. Spec step 4 (MakeDataViewWithBufferWitnessRecord) has no separate code; it is folded into the helpers, which take the view object directly. Since no user code runs between the steps, this is not observable.
